stories.title: Explainability API Contract in Facade
stories.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include explainability objects in responses for provider and clinical trial evaluations, ensuring consistent contract shape for downstream consumers.

stories.title: Facade Integration with Provider Signals
stories.description: Integrate explainability builder into provider evaluation flow so that credential verification and external links (EVAL-F1, EVAL-F2) are accompanied by structured explanations.

stories.title: Facade Integration with Clinical Trial Signals
stories.description: Integrate explainability builder into clinical trial evaluation flow so that trial phase, status, and eligibility signals (EVAL-F3) include standardized explanations.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Explainability Builder
stories.description: Create unit tests validating that explainability objects correctly populate source, meaning, and limitations across provider and trial inputs, including edge cases and missing data.

stories.title: Integration Tests for Explainability End-to-End
stories.description: Implement integration tests verifying that explainability metadata flows from domain services through facade, tool_router, and into rendered chat responses without schema breakage.
